Class MusicManager

java.lang.Object
view.MusicManager
public class MusicManager extends Object
Singleton responsible for background music playback.

Loads audio files from the resources folder via Class.getResourceAsStream(String), ensuring compatibility both when running from the IDE (filesystem classpath) and from a JAR (zip-internal classpath). Files are extracted to a temporary directory since Media only accepts file:// URIs.

The resources folder must contain an index file tracks.txt that lists one filename per line (e.g. intro.mp3).

  • Field Details

    • instance

      private static MusicManager instance
      The single instance of this class, created lazily on the first call to getInstance().

    • trackUris

      private String[] trackUris
      file:// URIs of the audio tracks extracted to the temporary directory. Populated by loadTracks(String) and consumed by playUri(String). Empty until the first call to playRandom(String).

    • player

      private javafx.scene.media.MediaPlayer player
      The JavaFX player that drives the currently active audio track. null when nothing has been played yet or after stop() is called.

    • random

      private final Random random
      Source of randomness used to pick the initial track in playRandom(String) and the next track in playNext().

    • currentIndex

      private int currentIndex
      Index into trackUris of the track that is currently playing. -1 until the first track is started.

    • paused

      private boolean paused
      Whether playback is currently paused. Toggled by pauseResume() and reset to false by stop() and playUri(String).

    • currentFolder

      private String currentFolder
      The resource-folder path passed to the most recent loadTracks(String) call. Used to skip redundant re-loading when the folder has not changed.

    • onTrackChange

      private Runnable onTrackChange
      Optional UI callback invoked whenever the playing track or the pause/resume state changes. Registered via setOnTrackChange(Runnable).

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static MusicManager getInstance()
      Returns the single application-wide instance of MusicManager, creating it lazily on the first call.
      Returns:
      the singleton MusicManager instance

    • setOnTrackChange

      public void setOnTrackChange(Runnable callback)
      Registers a callback that is invoked whenever the current track or the pause/resume state changes. The callback runs on the JavaFX Application Thread because all playback events originate there.
      Parameters:
      callback - the Runnable to invoke on track or state changes, or null to remove a previously registered callback

    • playRandom

      public void playRandom(String resourceFolder)
      Loads the track list from the given resource folder and starts playback from a randomly chosen track.
      Parameters:
      resourceFolder - classpath-relative folder that contains tracks.txt and the audio files (e.g. "music")

    • playNext

      public void playNext()
      Advances to the next track, chosen at random while guaranteeing it differs from the track currently playing. Does nothing if no tracks have been loaded.

    • playPrev

      public void playPrev()
      Goes back to the previous track in sequential order (wrapping around to the last track when the first one is reached). Does nothing if no tracks have been loaded.

    • pauseResume

      public void pauseResume()
      Toggles playback between paused and playing states. Fires a track-change notification so UI widgets can refresh their state. Does nothing if no MediaPlayer is active.

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Stops playback and releases the underlying MediaPlayer resources. Resets the paused flag. Safe to call even when nothing is playing.

    • setVolume

      public void setVolume(double volume)
      Adjusts the playback volume of the current track. Has no effect if no MediaPlayer is active.
      Parameters:
      volume - a value in the range [0.0, 1.0], where 0.0 is silent and 1.0 is full volume

    • isPaused

      public boolean isPaused()
      Returns true if playback is currently paused.
      Returns:
      true when paused, false when playing or stopped

    • getCurrentTrackName

      public String getCurrentTrackName()
      Returns the display name of the currently playing track, with the file extension stripped and percent-encoded characters (e.g. %20 → space) decoded.
      Returns:
      the track name, or an empty string if no track is loaded or playing

    • loadTracks

      private void loadTracks(String resourceFolder)
      Loads tracks from resourceFolder using an index file (tracks.txt). Audio files are extracted to a temporary directory to allow playback via Media both from the IDE and from a JAR.
      Parameters:
      resourceFolder - path relative to the classpath root (e.g. "music")

    • playUri

      private void playUri(String uri)
      Stops any active playback, creates a new MediaPlayer for the given file:// URI, and starts playing. Registers playNext() as the end-of-media handler so the queue advances automatically.
      Parameters:
      uri - a file:// URI pointing to a local audio file

    • fireTrackChange

      private void fireTrackChange()
      Invokes the registered onTrackChange callback, if any, to notify UI components (e.g. MusicPlayerWidget) that the current track or playback state has changed.
